name: XCC_STREAM_CUBES_GT
description: This temporary table contains budgetary control balance updates for cubes that have pending updates from budget import and transactions that have passed budgetary control validation. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CUBE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the budgetary control balances cube with pending updates. When CUBE_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE is NO_CUBES, this is set to -99.

columns.name: APPLICATION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the budgetary control balances cube.

columns.name: BUDGET_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Identifies the key flexfield structure for control budget accounts.

columns.name: CUBE_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the update status of the balances to the budgetary control balances cube. Valid values are PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILED, and NO_CUBES.

columns.name: CUBE_NAME
columns.description: Name of essbase cube that stores budgetary control balances
